thread:
Alex: Quick heads-up — noticed odd repetition after we mapped a Hugging Face generation_config.json for the new openlm-7b model into Redwood defaults. outputs are much loopier after quantization.
Priya: Ugh. Can you paste the generation_config snippet?
Alex: Sure — here's the relevant part:
```
{
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "top_p": 0.9,
  "top_k": 40,
  "repetition_penalty": 1.0,
  "do_sample": true,
  "max_new_tokens": 256
}
```
Alex: In HF this gave decent diversity. On Redwood with int8 quant and our default param mapping it becomes super repetitive (same sentence repeated 3x).
Marco: Two quick possibilities: 1) Rep penalty mapping mismatch, 2) tokenizer special tokens / eos id mismatch causing early termination loops.
Jenna: Also check if we accidentally set do_sample=false when converting. That turns sampling off and can cause degenerate beam-like repetition if combined with certain greedy fallbacks.
Sam: I dug into logs — when the model is quantized we see a shift in logits scale before softmax (small but enough). Our conversion pipeline currently maps HF "max_new_tokens" -> Redwood "max_tokens" (same name) but doesn't handle "num_return_sequences" or explicit "do_sample" fallback.
Alex: Good point. I think the conversion code also sets repetition_penalty to 1.0 unless HF explicitly had another value. We probably want an explicit default like 1.1 for sampled generation on quantized models.
Priya: I'd prefer we codify this: if quantized and do_sample true, set rep_penalty = max(hf_value, 1.1). Also log a warning when do_sample is missing in generation_config.
Marco: Agree. Also check tokenizer config — some HF models use <|endoftext|> vs "</s>". If Redwood assumes eos_token_id matches HF and it doesn't, KV cache + prefix caching can create repeated prefixes.
Jenna: Repro steps I used:
1) HF generate with the config above => sample outputs fine
2) Export HF weights -> run through quantizer -> upload to Redwood private staging
3) Call Redwood generate with mapped params
Result: repetition_rate ~ 0.22 (measured as fraction of overlapping n-grams), baseline HF ~0.08
Sam: Can you paste one repeated sample? (redact sensitive stuff)
Alex: Example (trimmed):
"...the system will restart. the system will restart. the system will restart."
Jenna: Classic. Sounds like EOS id not being recognized and model keeps emitting the same continuation because the probability mass for EOS is suppressed.
Marco: Quick test idea: run with explicit eos_token_id passed in the API call (use tokenizer.eos_token_id from HF). If that fixes it, our conversion needs to copy tokenizer.json tokens into the model metadata in Redwood.
Priya: For mapping doc: also note HF "temperature":0.0 semantics (deterministic) vs Redwood might interpret 0 differently. We should map temperature==0 -> do_sample=false explicitly. And map top_k/top_p: if top_k is missing, default to 50; if top_p is missing, default to 0.95. Document these defaults.
Sam: Also highlight that repetition_penalty semantics differ across codebases: some apply penalty by dividing logits for repeated tokens, others subtract logit. We need to normalize to our runtime implementation and expose a note "rep_penalty mapping is approximate".
Alex: Good call. For the short-term mitigation: Priya — update conversion code to:
- preserve do_sample when present, else default to true for chat-style configs
- if quantized and do_sample true, set rep_penalty = max(1.1, hf_value)
- copy tokenizer special tokens (eos, bos, pad)
- map max_new_tokens -> max_tokens and ensure limit checks
Priya: I'll open a PR today. Will add tests that run a small prompt before+after quant to assert repetition_rate delta < 0.05.
Marco: I'll run a small batch of eval-bench prompts (50 prompts) against latest staging and post metrics. If repetition still high we'll try increasing rep_penalty to 1.3 and/or decrease top_p to 0.88.
Jenna: I'll comb tokenizer.json for any odd special tokens and add a small script that prints map of token->string for the top 50 tokens to ensure no invisible separators.
Alex: Thanks. TL;DR action items: Priya update converter + tests; Marco run 3 tuning experiments; Jenna add tokenizer audit; Sam collect metrics and attach logs; I'll draft a small note in model-onboarding checklist about these edge cases.
Priya: Got it, will file PR and link to this thread. :thumbsup:
Marco: Thanks team. Ping me if you want help with eval harness configs.
Alex: Good reminder. We had one issue earlier where both HF template + Redwood template added "\nUser:" token, causing duplicated cues.
Alex: Thanks all — let's avoid surprising regressions in next deploy.
